svg.desc: Katameya Hospital LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT Katamya Clinic for Medical Services COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2019 75 million EGP DISCIPLINES Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Completed in 2019, this 2,400 m2 private hospital in New Cairo was developed for Katameya Clinic for Medical Services, with a construction value of 75 million EGP, designed to optimize space and enhance the experience for both doctors and patients. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management.
